name: fc660-bus-glue
description: Gentle UADx Fairchild 660 leveling/glue for a mix bus or 2-bus: light input drive, threshold 5, Time Constant 5 (program-dependent dual auto-release for transparent, breathing recovery), sidechain filter 90 Hz so low end doesn't pump the whole mix. A vintage-tube alternative to a VCA glue comp — adds tube weight + cohesion at only a couple dB of leveling. Measured on the Watercolors warm drum bus: crest 17.17->16.52, LRA 2.44->1.84 (tighter), +0.61 LU, true-peak -0.99 — gentle tube cohesion + weight.
intended_for: a stereo mix bus / 2-bus that wants subtle tube cohesion + weight without obvious compression
plugin_build: uaudio_fairchild_660.vst3 (UADx native — renders headless; not the .component twin)
notes: Time Constant 5/6 are the program-dependent AUTO positions (a fast first stage + a long secondary release) — smoother/denser on busy material; 4 is the most open. Re-dial TIME_CONST by ear/crest.
Threshold is relative to input level: higher thresh = more GR on this build. Keep it gentle (a couple dB) for glue, not squash.
It's a glue/color stage, NOT a master/limiter — hand off to master-track for loudness/limiting.
For a TRUE stereo bus the 670 (with L-R/L-V matrix + link) is the purist choice; the 660 runs dual-mono.
